description: Imagined photorealistic portrait, not an archival photograph.
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: wide hero illustration for a technical blog essay about the impossibility of perfect LLM guardrails.
Primary request: A photorealistic imagined portrait of Kurt Gödel, the Austrian logician, shrugging his shoulders like the shrug emoji: both shoulders visibly raised, both elbows bent, both open hands held palm-up at shoulder height, with a quietly bemused, resigned expression.
Subject: Gödel in his middle age, recognizable narrow face, high forehead, neatly combed dark hair with receding temples, round wire-rimmed spectacles, clean-shaven, wearing a period-appropriate dark suit, white shirt and tie.
Scene/backdrop: a simple softly out-of-focus mid-century academic study, understated and uncluttered.
Style/medium: photorealistic black-and-white editorial portrait with subtle film grain, believable skin and wool fabric texture, natural window light. An imagined scene, not a reproduction of a real archival photograph.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, waist-up, face near the center, leave ample room around both fully visible hands so the shrug silhouette is instantly readable, direct eye contact.
Constraints: anatomically natural arms and hands with five fingers each; no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people; avoid caricature and cartoon styling.
